newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish May retail sales value up 2.0 pct m/m-CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish May retail sales value up 2.0 pct m/m-CSO.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales rose a provisional seasonally-adjusted 2.0 percent in May, giving a year-on-year increase of 6.5 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Friday.
In April, the value of retail sales fell 1.5 percent over the month and was up 4.9 percent year-on-year. This was unchanged from provisional estimates.
The CSO said the value index was a provisional seasonally adjusted 142.7 in May and a final 139.9 in April.
